using namespace std;

// ---------- IntList ----------
class IntList {
public:
    vector<int> data;
    int size;

    IntList() : size(0) {
        data.reserve(3);
    }

    bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }
    int size() const { return size; }

    int get(int index) const {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        return data[index];
    }

    void clear() { size = 0; }

    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void expand() {
        if (size >= (int)data.capacity()) {
            data.reserve((data.capacity() << 1) + 1);
        }
    }

    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        expand();
        data.insert(data.begin() + index, value);
        size++;
    }

    int deleteAt(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        int value = data[index];
        data.erase(data.begin() + index);
        size--;
        return value;
    }

    void push(int value) {
        expand();
        data.push_back(value);
        size++;
    }

    int pop() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        int value = data.back();
        data.pop_back();
        size--;
        return value;
    }

    void unshift(int value) {
        expand();
        data.insert(data.begin(), value);
        size++;
    }

    int shift() {
        if (size == 0) throw runtime_error("No such element");
        int value = data.front();
        data.erase(data.begin());
        size--;
        return value;
    }

    int* dataPtr() { return data.data(); }
    const int* dataPtr() const { return data.data(); }
};

// ---------- Free list for IntList ----------
static vector<IntList> freeLists;

static IntList takeList() {
    if (freeLists.empty()) {
        return IntList();
    } else {
        IntList lst = move(freeLists.back());
        freeLists.pop_back();
        lst.clear();
        return lst;
    }
}

static void putList(IntList& lst) {
    lst.clear();
    freeLists.push_back(move(lst));
}

// ---------- IntIntMap ----------
class IntIntMap {
public:
    static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;

    vector<int> data;
    int size;

    IntIntMap() : size(0) {
        data.resize(4);
        data[0] = EMPTY;
        data[2] = EMPTY;
    }

    bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }
    int size() const { return size; }

    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)data.size(); i += 2) {
            data[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        size = 0;
    }

    static int hash(int key) {
        int h = key * 1000000007;
        h ^= h >> 16;
        h ^= h >> 24;
        return h;
    }

    bool have(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int mask = data.size() - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask; ; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) return true;
            if (cur == EMPTY) return false;
        }
    }

    int get(int key, int default_) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int mask = data.size() - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask; ; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) return data[i + 1];
            if (cur == EMPTY) return default_;
        }
    }

    static vector<int> resize(const vector<int>& oldData, int newCapacity) {
        int oldCapacity = oldData.size();
        vector<int> newData(newCapacity);
        for (int i = 0; i < newCapacity; i += 2) {
            newData[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        int mask = newCapacity - 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < oldCapacity; i += 2) {
            int cur = oldData[i];
            if (cur == EMPTY) continue;
            for (int j = hash(cur) & mask; ; j = (j - 1) & mask) {
                if (newData[j] == EMPTY) {
                    newData[j] = cur;
                    newData[j + 1] = oldData[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return newData;
    }

    void set(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int capacity = data.size();
        int mask = capacity - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask; ; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                data[i + 1] = value;
                return;
            }
            if (cur == EMPTY) {
                data[i] = key;
                data[i + 1] = value;
                size++;
                if (size > capacity >> 2) {
                    data = resize(data, capacity << 1);
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void deleteKey(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) throw invalid_argument("Key is EMPTY");
        int capacity = data.size();
        int mask = capacity - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask; ; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                for (int j = i; ; ) {
                    cur = data[j = (j - 1) & mask];
                    if (cur == EMPTY) {
                        data[i] = EMPTY;
                        size--;
                        return;
                    }
                    int k = hash(cur) & mask;
                    if ((k >= i) ^ (k < j) ^ (i < j)) {
                        data[i] = cur;
                        data[i + 1] = data[j + 1];
                        i = j;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (cur == EMPTY) return;
        }
    }

    void expand(int newCapacity) {
        int oldCapacity = data.size();
        if (oldCapacity >> 2 < newCapacity) {
            int highest = 1;
            while (highest < newCapacity) highest <<= 1;
            data = resize(data, highest << 3);
        }
    }

    void shrink() {
        int oldCapacity = data.size();
        if (oldCapacity > 4 && oldCapacity >> 3 >= size) {
            int highest = 1;
            while (highest < size) highest <<= 1;
            data = resize(data, max(highest << 3, 4));
        }
    }

    // Iterator (minimal, not used in solve)
    class Iterator {
    public:
        const vector<int>& data;
        int position;

        Iterator(const vector<int>& d) : data(d), position(-2) {
            advance();
        }

        bool hasNext() const { return position < (int)data.size(); }
        int getKey() const { return data[position]; }
        int getValue() const { return data[position + 1]; }

        void advance() {
            do {
                position += 2;
            } while (position < (int)data.size() && data[position] == EMPTY);
        }
    };

    Iterator iterator() const { return Iterator(data); }
};

// ---------- Global variables ----------
static int n, m;
static string line;
static istringstream iss;

// ---------- I/O helpers ----------
static int scanInt() {
    int val;
    iss >> val;
    return val;
}

static long long scanLong() {
    long long val;
    iss >> val;
    return val;
}

static string scanString() {
    string s;
    iss >> s;
    return s;
}

// ---------- Solve function ----------
static IntList solve(int from, int to) {
    IntList res;
    if (from + 1 == to) {
        res = takeList();
        res.push(from);
        if (from + m > n) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from - n);
        }
        res.push(m);
        if (from > m) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from);
        }
        res.push(-from);
    } else {
        int mid = (from + to) >> 1;
        IntList a = solve(from, mid);
        IntList b = solve(mid, to);
        res = takeList();
        int aSize = a.size;
        int bSize = b.size;
        int* aData = a.dataPtr();
        int* bData = b.dataPtr();
        for (int i = 0; ; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = (i == 0) ? 0 : bData[i - 1];
            int bTo = (i == bSize - 1) ? n : bData[i + 1];
            int bShift = bData[i];
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo = bTo + bShift;
            int l = 0, r = aSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (aData[m] <= aFrom) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            int cur = l;
            while (true) {
                res.push(bShift + aData[cur]);
                ++cur;
                if (cur == aSize) break;
                int pos = aData[cur];
                if (pos >= aTo) break;
                res.push(pos - bShift);
                ++cur;
            }
            if (i == bSize - 1) break;
            res.push(bTo);
        }
        putList(a);
        putList(b);
    }
    return res;
}

static void solve() {
    n = scanInt();
    m = scanInt();
    int s = scanInt() - 1;
    long long t = scanLong();
    for (int ct = (int)(t % n); ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += ct;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= ct;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
    }
    long long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve.size;
        int* csData = cycleSolve.dataPtr();
        IntList cycleList = takeList();
        IntIntMap cycleMap;
        for (int it = 0; ; it++) {
            if (it == cycles) break;
            int prev = cycleMap.get(s, -1);
            if (prev >= 0) {
                s = cycleList.get(prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (it - prev)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList.push(s);
            cycleMap.set(s, it);
            int l = 0, r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (csData[m] <= s) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            s += csData[l];
        }
    }
    cout << (s + 1) << endl;
}

int main() {
    try {
        getline(cin, line);
        iss.str(line);
        solve();
    } catch (const exception& e) {
        cerr << e.what() << endl;
        exit(1);
    }
    return 0;
}
